input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 imposes insurance obligations on Vendor at or above our preferred position: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law (plus employer's liability USD 1M), E&O of USD 2M, and cyber/privacy liability of USD 5M, maintained throughout the term and for one year afterward. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, primary-coverage and cancellation-notice language, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. No redline needed.
